extracted.intended_audience: potential nominees, nominators, and the general public interested in the MacArthur Fellows program
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the MacArthur Fellows Program's selection characteristics for awarding unrestricted fellowships to individuals across disciplines; summarizes the program's evaluative emphasis (originality, dedication, self-direction) and program features (unrestricted support, broad spectrum of endeavors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unrestricted fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: The MacArthur Fellows Program awards unrestricted fellowships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowships are not tied to a specific project or budget — recipients receive support without programmatic restrictions (implied by the term 'unrestricted fellowships').

rubrics_metrics.name: Extraordinary originality
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals who have shown extraordinary originality in their creative pursuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection emphasizes genuinely original work or ideas; the page uses the exact phrase 'extraordinary originality' as a key evaluative quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dedication in creative pursuits
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals who have shown dedication in their creative pursuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustained commitment to one's work or field is presented as a selection factor; the page pairs this with originality as central to selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marked capacity for self-direction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators look for fellows who can direct their own work independently — demonstrated ability to set and pursue an original course without needing directed oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-disciplinary / broad spectrum eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows work 'across a broad spectrum of endeavors' (examples include pediatric neurosurgeon, marine ecologist, journalist, photographer, optical physicist and astronomer, stringed-instrument bow maker, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program considers and awards individuals from many fields rather than confining eligibility to a single discipline; diversity of practice is indicated by the range of example fellows listed.
